newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's NLCF buys 157,500T corn, passes 52,500T.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's NLCF buys 157,500T corn, passes 52,500T.

text.p: South Korea's National Livestock Cooperatives Federation (NLCF) bought 157,500 tonnes of corn, and passed on a tender for 52,500 tonnes due to high prices, an NLCF official said on Thursday.
The official said the tenders were divided into four positions, each for 52,500 tonnes. It bought the second and fourth positions at basis over futures on the Chicago Board of Trade.
He said it bought corn from world-wide origins.
Arrival was set for Inchon and Ulsan.
Details for the tender are as follows: POSITION TONNE ETA SELLER/PRICE
Three 52,500 Aug 10 Nidera /$0.7244 over July futures
Four 52,500 Aug 30 Tradi /$0.7150 over July futures
